title: 2 Queen Mary Postcards Long Beach CA Mike Roberts B2174 B2175 Unposted Lot
condition_description: Both unposted and unwritten. Deckle edges, light toning on the backs; B2174 has a small soft corner at the top left. See photos.
description:
Two Official Queen Mary Souvenir postcards, City of Long Beach, California. Published by Mike Roberts, Berkeley ("the Continental card"), circa 1970s.

You get:
- B2174 - the Queen Mary's clean white side and famous three stacks, looking down the row of portside lifeboats toward the docking bridge
- B2175 - the Queen Mary's stern with sunset reflecting off the portside, tour boarding ramps at left, propeller housing at the water line

Both unposted and blank on the back. Deckle (scalloped) edges, light toning on the backs. See photos.

Ships flat with a stiffener in a protective mailer.
